question: What is the true nature of the self beyond bodily support?
premises: The self is identified as I alone
The self has the form of a net
The self is devoid of a supporting body
inference: The self alone is of net-like form and devoid of a supporting body
uncertainties: The metaphor jāla-rūpaḥ admits multiple interpretations
plain_english: I alone am of the form of a net and devoid of a supporting body.
